newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hogy Medical says to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Hogy Medical says to buy back shares.

text.p: Hogy Medical Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it planned to buy up to 188,000 of its own shares, or up to 1.2 billion yen worth, in order to introduce a stock option scheme for senior employees.

The formal decision on the plan will be made at an annual shareholders' meeting due to be held in late June, it said in a statement. Stock options are the right to buy shares at a set price within a certain period.

Japan's parliament last Friday approved changes to the commercial code to allow firms to buy back up to 10 percent of their own shares for use in stock-option schemes for employees and executives. The change will take effect from June 1.
Hogy Medical makes disposable surgical gowns.
